Workforce posture · Baseline / Current Plan

OCFO is 85% staffed to mission — short 103 FTE, $7.1M over the personnel topline, and risk concentrates in Internal Controls and Fin. Systems.

The shortfall is concentrated in our highest-criticality divisions — sequencing fills there protects mission delivery first. At the current pace, attrition outpaces hiring and authorized vacancies will not close without intervention.
